# FLOAT16_INV_PI

> Inverse of the mathematical constant [π][pi].

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var FLOAT16_INV_PI = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/inv-pi' );
```

#### FLOAT16_INV_PI

Inverse of the mathematical constant [π][pi].

```javascript
var bool = ( FLOAT16_INV_PI === 0.31835937 );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var FLOAT16_INV_PI = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/inv-pi' );

console.log( FLOAT16_INV_PI );
// => 0.31835937
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
